ambiguities: Ocean current process differs from persistent flow configuration; no subject Current invented for quota.
MarineEstuary excludes freshwater estuaries; jargon alias must not equate all estuaries.
Mobile water mass cannot derive from geostationary Location; fluid-body upstream distinction needed.
Practical and absolute salinity not equivalent: chemistry/physics upstream issue.
Tidal stage is contextual cyclic distinction, not generic calendar machinery.

coverage.source_limits: Agency primary materials are bounded starting evidence, often educational/descriptive. Sources do not endorse ontological categories, exact inferred bindings or exhaustive coverage. Retrieval failures are recorded per source.

coverage.held_out_status: No independently authored held-out probes obtained. Questions were source-first but author knew legacy and is not independent; request fresh human/domain probes after freezing revision.
